notes.title: Boxhead:immortal Development Briefing
notes.content:
[b]Project & Team Restructuring [/b]
	
We were forced to make the difficult decision of restructuring our main development team and plans for the project. We have recruited talented new developers to the team, but recent progress has been slow due to project handover.

The project is back on track under new leadership and we are optimistic about future updates that we have planned. Thank you for your continued support and patience.

As we continue to improve our game’s identity, the next set of planned updates focus on gameplay mechanics, visual upgrades, and content. You can expect new weapons, characters, UI improvements, enemy types, game mechanics, and more. 

· (New weapon modeling!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923098/8abc20291a355ca248cde7f97f2bdeb2648b74f8.png[/img]

Modular weapon upgrades  - This new system introduces multiple new upgrades for weapons in the form of modular weapon parts. This new mechanic will reduce weapon clutter in cards without sacrificing gun variety, since a gun will have multiple parts for you to choose from. Weapon components will affect the performance of the weapon, enabling you to customize and build the perfect zombie killing machine.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Remote Co-op Mode: Play [i]Boxhead: Immortal[/i] remotely with your friends! Use the "Multiplayer" button to create a room, and then invite your Steam friends to join the battlefield.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923098/e9eaeebf2cc27ad17a4eb65059819282f88a7f22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923098/74896b13c13054ac0ace7b5c9684ca15997171f4.png[/img]
[*] [b]Friendly Fire Protection Mechanism[/b]: When friendly fire is enabled, firearms will only cause 40% damage to teammates. Additionally, for each challenge mode selected, damage to teammates increases by 20% (e.g., if all 4 challenge modes are chosen, damage to teammates will be 120%).
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923098/51fe184ea57c27f3a0653259dfc85dd2e4dd5014.png[/img]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Adjustment to Support Active Skill 3 (bombardment)[/b]: Small-scale bombardments have been removed. Instead, each bombardment generates ashes, dealing a larger area-of-effect attack to monsters, dealing 20% bombardment DMG. Additionally, affected monsters will suffer continuous bleeding (losing 40 HP every 1s or 4% max HP, whichever is higher, for 5s).
[*] [b]Weapon Upgrade Adjustments[/b]:
[list]
[*] Pistol “Lightweighting”: Mobility increased by 25%, and movement SPD increased by 25% → Mobility increased by 40%, and movement SPD increased by 10%
[*] SMG: 
[list]
[*] “Polymer Modification”: Mobility increased by 25%, and movement SPD increased by 25% → Mobility increased by 40%, and movement SPD increased by 10%
[*] “Special Ammunition”: blast radius: 2m → 2.5m, DMG: 80% → 50%
[/list]
[*] Rifle “Lightweight Handguard”: Mobility increased by 15%, and movement SPD increased by 15% → Mobility increased by 40%, and movement SPD increased by 10%
[/list]
by 10% (previously 15% each).
[*] [b]Adjusted Monster HP Enhancement Mechanism and Explanation[/b]: When there are more than one player in the game, each additional player increases zombie max HP by 50%. This enhancement is independent of the “2x Monster Health” challenge mode.
[*] Performance Optimization.
[*] Optimized some sound effects.
[/olist]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed bug where players were unable to use weapons after using the rocket.
[*] Fixed bug causing occasional lower firearms DMG.
[*] Fixed bug related to abnormal fire damage caused by Support’s explosives.
[*] Fixed bug causing abnormal monsters’ max HP.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Save Feature Added[/b]: [b]The game will now automatically save at the end of each flag or after gacha[/b]. A save icon will appear in the top right corner of the screen during the save process. Please note, if you exit the game before a flag ends, it will not be saved.
[*] [b]In-Game Score Incentive Mechanics Adjusted[/b]: [b]The buff from scoring every 10,000 points has been changed to every 20,000 points[/b]. Additionally, [b]a new buff has been added that reduces the cooldown of the player’s active skills[/b]. Each stack increases cooldown reduction by 2.5%, max 10 stacks. (Cooldown reduction decreases the waiting time for active skills to be available again)
[*] [b]Buff Effect Adjustments[/b]: The Doctor’s passive skill 3 and attribute enhancement 3 (team/self recovery rate increase), as well as the in-game score buff for recovery rate, have all been changed to increase the player’s [b]incoming healing bonus[/b]. (Recovery rate only affects the amount of health restored by the character’s natural regeneration, while incoming healing bonus will affect all forms of healing)
[*] Supporter Skill Adjustments:
Active Skill 1 (rocket ammunition box): Each player can place a maximum of 3 at a time. CD: 25s → 30s.
Active Skill 2 (High-Explosive Ammunition box): Each player can place a maximum of 3 at a time. CD: 30s → 37s.
[*] Sapper Skill Adjustments:
Active Skill 3 (Armor Box): CD: 40s → 30s.
[*] High-Explosive Grenade Enhancement: Detonation delay time: 1s → 0.1s.
[*] Supply Box Healing Adjustment: A supply box now only recover 50% max HP.
[*] Adjusted the Collision Volume of Sandbags.
[*] Optimized some sound effects and UI presentations.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with abnormal monster HP.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The initial pistol is no longer unified as Block. Instead, each role now has its own exclusive pistol.[/b] When drawing cards, you can choose between [i][b]B44[/b][/i] and Beagle pistols to replace the default one.
Specific pistols for each role:
[list]
[*] Gunfighter: BSP
[*] Support: B226
[*] Sapper: [i][b]B&P9[/b][/i]
[*] Medic: Block
[/list]
[i][b]B44[/b][/i] and [b][i]B&P9[/i][/b] are newly added pistols, replacing the previous B1911.
[*] [b]When choosing challenge mode, you can now select multiple challenge modes[/b], and the final score multiplier will accumulate accordingly.
[*] The waiting time after drawing cards has been extended to 30s, and a skip function has been added.
[*] Nano Enhancer weakened:
[list]
[*] Acceleration ratio: 25% → 15%
[*] Duration: 10s → 8s
[/list]
[*] Corrosive Barrel enhancement:
[list]
[*] Debuff duration: 3s → 5s
[/list]
[*] Performance optimization for flame effects.
[*] Optimized and adjusted the volume and performance of some firearm sound effects.
[*] Adjusted the transparency and trigger range of in-game prompts for supply boxes, ammo boxes, etc.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where explosive flames for Support were ineffective.
[*] Fixed bug where zombie numbers did not match the description when selecting the 1.5x zombie spawn challenge.
[*] Fixed bug where zombie HP did not match the description when selecting the 2x zombie health challenge.
[*] Fixed bug where certain firearms had a chance of hitting players themselves due to excessive firing rate.
[*] Fixed issues related to weapon switching.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Hello, [i]Boxheads[/i]! We’re thrilled to introduce fresh game content that will enhance your gaming experience. Let’s dive into the details.

[b]New Additions[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Each role now has exclusive items[/b], replacing the previous place items and throwns. Here are the details:
[list]
[*] Gunfighter
[list]
[*] [b]Cluster Grenade[/b]: Throws an explosive that splits into multiple smaller grenades upon detonation.
[*] [b]Claymore[/b]: Explodes and scatters high-damage steel balls in a fan-shaped area in front.
[/list]
[*] Support
[list]
[*] [b]Molotov Cocktails[/b]: Creates a fiery area upon impact, continuously damaging and slowing down zombies. It also applies a vulnerability effect, significantly increasing the damage they take.
[*] [b]Explosion-Proof Sandbag[/b]: Has higher durability than fake walls and significantly reduces damage from explosive sources.
[/list]
[*] Sapper
[list]
[*] [b]High-Explosive Grenade[/b]: Slightly smaller blast radius than the original grenade but deals substantial damage.
[*] [b]Electric Trap[/b]: Can immobilize monsters while inflicting minor damage. Limited usage and can be attacked by devil.
[/list]
[*] Medic
[list]
[*] [b]Corrosive Barrel[/b]: Explodes, causing continuous bleeding and slowing down monsters hit.
[*] [b]Nano Enhancer[/b]: Place a medical box on the ground, granting a short-duration boost to movement speed, firearm firing rate, and max HP when picked up.
[/list]
[/list]
[*] [b]In-Game Score Incentive Mechanics[/b]
For every 10,000 points earned, randomly boost one of the following attributes for all players by 5%: max HP, movement SPD, firearm firing rate, or HP recovery rate. Each attribute can be boosted up to 10 times.
[*] [b]New Challenge Mode[/b]
Before starting a game, players can choose a challenge mode. In challenge mode, zombies gain buffs, and players receive a score multiplier. There are four challenge modes:
1.5x zombie spawns, score × 1.25
2x monster HP, score × 1.5
2x monster damage, score × 2
2.5x devil spawns, score × 2.5
[*] [b]Dynamic Accuracy Mechanics for Firearms[/b]:
Prolonged use of a specific gun increases its deviation angle. Different firearms have varying durations. Higher accuracy, lower damage, or worse knockback effect firearms can be used for longer periods.
[*] Effective Range Mechanism for Firearms:
Hitting targets within the effective range grants a 25% damage bonus. Beyond the effective range, damage is reduced by 25%, and at extreme distances, shots miss. This damage multiplier is independent. For example, Gun X has an effective range of 8-10 units and a maximum range of 12 units.
Within 8 units, damage increases.
Between 8-10 units, damage remains unchanged.
Between 10-12 units, damage decreases.
Beyond 12 units, shots miss.
Due to workload reasons, we will update the redrawn gacha cards as soon as possible, and the new card’s firearm values will match the actual values.
[/olist]

[b]Changes[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Weapon Switch Logic Optimization[/b]
Removed weapon type switching keys; now use previous/next weapon keys. Numeric keys allow quick switching. The combined mouse and keyboard control users can use the mouse wheel to switch weapons.
[*] [b]Optimized the gacha interface operations[/b]
Now you can use keyboard to control.
[*] [b]Supply Box Refill Logic Adjustment[/b]
When the current weapon is a pistol, prioritize replenishing other weapons.
[*] [b]Support’s Bombardment Active Skill Adjustment[/b]
After each bombardment, there will be an additional 3 small-scale bombardment.
[*] [b]Adjusted Firearm Ranges[/b]
Adjusted the range of some firearms to match the new mechanics.
[*] Enhanced Devil Destruction Logic Devils are now more effective at destroying place items and more intelligent when destroying.
[/olist]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed bug related to shared screen visibility in two-player mode.
[*] Fixed issues causing a black screen with specific graphics cards.
[*] Fixed bug of throwns passing through walls.
[/olist]
